title: Polynomial algebra model after scalar extension killing pi
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures from R and R2=R/(pi^2) to Cbar. Let d be prepared polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation] and D its explicit lifting quotient. Write A=d.reducedQuotient and ak=d.reducedElement(k). Let c:Cbar to D/(pi D) be an R-algebra map sending epsilon(X_i) to x_i modulo pi. Let B be a commutative R-algebra and R2-algebra, with a compatible scalar tower, such that pi maps to zero in B. Choose a chart k and s in D whose image modulo pi is c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))). Set t=1 tensor s in B tensor_R D. Then the polynomial algebra on the finite set E_k over B tensor_R2 A[1/ak] is isomorphic as a B-algebra to (B tensor_R D)[1/t]. No field or prime assumption is made. Localizations are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away].

proof.text: Extend hc from original variables to all original-variable polynomials by MvPolynomial.algHom_ext. Thus hs identifies the classes of s and the canonical a_k lift modulo pi. Their difference lies in the principal ideal (pi). Its image under includeRight into B tensor_R D is zero because pi maps to zero in B. Rewrite the requested localization as localization at the canonical a_k image.

proof.text: Define J_k to be generated by all u_l and the single chart k relations p_kl. This is a subideal of the full defining ideal, so construct the canonical surjective quotient map phi:ULift(Q/J_k) to D explicitly. Its tensor extension f with B is surjective by Algebra.TensorProduct.map_surjective.

proof.text: Every full original equation vanishes in Q/J_k by definition. Apply the other-chart relation calculation for every p_kprime,l. Hence the evaluation map from Q to the localization of B tensor_R ULift(Q/J_k) kills the full defining ideal. Use Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor_ker to identify the kernel of f with the ideal generated by the tensor images of ker(phi). Quotient induction and the preceding ideal inclusion show that this entire kernel dies in the source localization.

proof.text: The localized-surjection helper proves injectivity by IsLocalization.Away.map_injective_iff and the localization zero criterion, and surjectivity by IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ_surjective_of_surjective. AlgEquiv.ofBijective therefore gives the equivalence of the localized single-chart and full quotients. Compose it with the single-chart polynomial equivalence, applying only hd.normalized_h for that equivalence. The image of the chart coefficient under f is definitionally the canonical a_k image in the full quotient.

theorem popescu_zero_base_chart_polynomial (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (B : Type b) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    (hπ : algebraMap R B π = 0) (k : Fin d.r) (s : d.liftingAlgebra)
    (hs : Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s = c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k)))) :
    Nonempty (MvPolynomial (d.E k)
      (B ⊗[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)]
        Localization.Away (d.reducedElement k)) ≃ₐ[B]
      Localization.Away
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B) s))
